reviews.review:
25% of my playtime may be the launcher downloading updates, but I seriously can't get away from this game. No matter how much it changes, how much the devs make or break it, I can't get out of it.

Sure it has its cons (grinding) and gameplay can get repetitive (grinding) at times, but it's overall one of the best games I've ever played.

I will say that it can be hard to get into at first, though, and it really helps if you do it with friends (which I guess is kinda expected for a 90%[i] co-op [/i]game).

[b]An Ever-Evolving Game[/b]

To say Warframe has changed over the years would be a major understatement. The game presented to players today barely ressembles the game I played 3 years ago.

That's great! Over the years, Warframe has been lovingly polished by its' developers into a free-to-play game that puts many premium priced games to shame. It's clear to anyone that Digital Extremes truly loves the game they have created - from the intriguing art style to the gameplay mechanics, Warframe is a labor of love.

[b]What is Warframe?[/b]

Warframe is a third-person, co-op, looter, mission-based shooter in which players take control of powerful Warframes (basically space-ninjas). The game focuses almost exclusively on PVE elements, although PVP elements are also provided. 

The core of the game sees players partaking in various missions to gather resources in order to build new equipment such as new Warframes, weapons, etc. In this aspect, the game can be quite a grind at times, but never unfair. As you may be aware, Warframe is free-to-play. It is [i]NOT[/i] pay-to-win. More on that later.

[b]How's the Gameplay?[/b]

The gameplay is fantastic! Each Warframe and weapon offers players wildly different play styles that best suit them. Players have incredible control over their mobility and experienced players can often look like performers on a stage. After playing countless games, I have yet to find one that offers the same freedom of movement and exilerating power that Warframe provides. It's pure power fantasy and I'm loving every second of it!

[b]Free-to-Play VS. Pay-to-Win[/b]

Ah, the topic we all love to talk about nowadays. It's true that many free-to-play (and even premium priced games) like to shake us for every penny we have on hand. Warframe is not one of those games. 

Sure, you can buy the premium currency - Platinum - for real world money and aquire new equipment. However, everything that is able to be purchased in this manner can also be obtained completely free by just playing the game. Furthermore, you cannot purchase advantages over others and Platinum itself can be earned by trading for it with other items in-game.

Overall, the existence of Platinum in Warframe is non-intrusive and does not negatively affect one's experience. 

[b]Give it a Try![/b]

Warframe is a game that might just suprise you with the level of depth that can be found. Take it from me, it can't hurt to just give it a try.
Amazing gameplay, story, graphics, optimization, devs, community and it's all FREE
